title: Acuerdo UE-Canadá: modificación de las concesiones en los contingentes arancelarios de la lista CLXXV de la Unión Europea
title_en: EU-Canada Agreement: modification of concessions on tariff rate quotas included in the EU Schedule CLXXV
scope: citado en documentos de agricultura y pesca del Consejo

council_docs.title: COUNCIL DECISION on the conclusion of the Agreement in the form of an Exchange of Letters between the European Union and Canada pursuant to Article XXVIII of the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade 1994 ('GATT 1994') relating to the modification of concessions on all the tariff-rate quotas included in the EU Schedule CLXXV as a consequence of the United Kingdom’s withdrawal from the European Union

Agreement in the form of an Exchange of Letters between the European Union and Canada pursuant to Article XXVIII of the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade 1994 ("GATT 1994") relating to the modification of concessions on all the tariff-rate quotas included in the EU Schedule CLXXV as a consequence of the United Kingdom's withdrawal from the European Union
